title: 0041 AI 비서 승인 카드 · 두 번 실행 막기 키 — 카드는 서버만, 정해진 상태 이동만 · 만든 칸은 그대로 · 24시간 기한 · 대화와 함께 지움, 프로젝트(업체) · 수금 · 원가(수주) 키 하나, 기록 종류 action (scripts/rls-probe.mjs)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.assistant_conversations (id, company_id, user_id, title) VALUES ({{conv_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'probe')
INSERT INTO public.customers (id, company_id, name) VALUES ({{cust_x}}, {{company_x}}, 'probe 고객'), ({{cust_y}}, {{company_y}}, 'probe 고객')
INSERT INTO public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title, idempotency_key) VALUES ({{proj_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{cust_x}}, 'probe', 'act:k1')
INSERT INTO public.designs (id, user_id, name, company_id) VALUES ({{design_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'probe', {{company_x}})
INSERT INTO public.design_snapshots (id, design_id, rev, content_hash, design_payload, bom_payload, item_count) VALUES ({{snap_x}}, {{design_x}}, 1, 'probe', '{}', '{}', 1)

INSERT INTO public.design_documents (id, design_id, snapshot_id, doc_type, rev, doc_no, title, render_payload, content_hash) VALUES ({{doc_x}}, {{design_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 'work_order', 1, 'probe-' || {{doc_x}}::text, 'probe', '{}', 'probe'), ({{doc_y}}, {{design_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 'work_order', 2, 'probe-' || {{doc_y}}::text, 'probe', '{}', 'probe')

INSERT INTO public.orders (id, order_no, design_id, document_id, snapshot_id, contract_amount, company_id, customer_name) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'probe-' || {{order_x}}::text, {{design_x}}, {{doc_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 0, {{company_x}}, '고객A')

INSERT INTO public.orders (id, order_no, design_id, document_id, snapshot_id, contract_amount, company_id, customer_name) VALUES ({{order_y}}, 'probe-' || {{order_y}}::text, {{design_x}}, {{doc_y}}, {{snap_x}}, 0, {{company_x}}, '고객B')
INSERT INTO public.order_payments (order_id, stage, amount, due_on, idempotency_key) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'deposit', 1000000, '2026-11-10', 'act:k1')
INSERT INTO public.order_costs (order_id, category, amount, idempotency_key) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'material', 300000, 'act:k1')

INSERT INTO public.assistant_actions (id, company_id, conversation_id, user_id, kind, state, params, expect, card) VALUES ({{act_a}}, {{company_x}}, {{conv_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'order_status', 'proposed', '{"order_id":"o"}'::jsonb, '{"status":"confirmed"}'::jsonb, '{"title":"t"}'::jsonb), ({{act_b}}, {{company_x}}, {{conv_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'consult_accept', 'proposed', '{"order_id":"o"}'::jsonb, '{"status":"confirmed"}'::jsonb, '{"title":"t"}'::jsonb), ({{act_d}}, {{company_x}}, {{conv_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'draft', 'draft', '{"order_id":"o"}'::jsonb, '{"status":"confirmed"}'::jsonb, '{"title":"t"}'::jsonb)

checks.name: 카드 — 서버만 읽는다 (구성원 · 남 · 익명 모두 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.assistant_actions where conversation_id = {{conv_x}}

checks.name: 카드 — 서버만 쓴다
checks.sql: update public.assistant_actions set state = 'rejected' where id = {{act_b}}

checks.name: 상태 이동 — proposed → running → done, 승인 · 끝 시각은 트리거가 찍는다, 결과는 끝날 때
checks.sql: update public.assistant_actions set state = 'running' where id = {{act_a}}; update public.assistant_actions set state = 'done', result = '{"order_id":"o"}'::jsonb where id = {{act_a}}; select state || '/' || (decided_at is not null) || '/' || (finished_at is not null) || '/' || (result->>'order_id') from public.assistant_actions where id = {{act_a}}

checks.name: 상태 이동 — 거절 · 기한 지남은 proposed 에서만, 끝난 카드는 다시 못 연다
checks.sql: update public.assistant_actions set state = 'rejected' where id = {{act_b}}; update public.assistant_actions set state = 'running' where id = {{act_b}}

checks.name: 상태 이동 — running 에서 거절로는 못 간다 · 한 번 잡은 카드를 다시 잡지 못한다
checks.sql: update public.assistant_actions set state = 'running' where id = {{act_b}}; update public.assistant_actions set state = 'running' where id = {{act_b}} and state = 'proposed'; select state from public.assistant_actions where id = {{act_b}}

checks.name: 만든 칸은 그대로 — 값 · 카드 · 기한을 고치면 거절
checks.sql: update public.assistant_actions set params = '{"order_id":"x"}'::jsonb where id = {{act_b}}

checks.name: 결과는 실행이 끝날 때만 — 거절하며 결과를 쓰면 거절
checks.sql: update public.assistant_actions set state = 'rejected', result = '{}'::jsonb where id = {{act_b}}

checks.name: 초안은 늘 draft — 다른 상태로 못 간다
checks.sql: update public.assistant_actions set state = 'running' where id = {{act_d}}

checks.name: 종류 · 상태 — 초안이 아닌 카드는 draft 가 될 수 없다
checks.sql: insert into public.assistant_actions (company_id, conversation_id, user_id, kind, state) values ({{company_x}}, {{conv_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'order_status', 'draft')

checks.name: 종류 — 모르는 종류(문서 발행)는 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.assistant_actions (company_id, conversation_id, user_id, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{conv_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'document_issue')

checks.name: 기한 — 기본 24시간
checks.sql: select (expires_at - created_at) = interval '24 hours' from public.assistant_actions where id = {{act_b}}

checks.name: 대화를 지우면 카드도 지운다
checks.sql: delete from public.assistant_conversations where id = {{conv_x}}; select count(*) from public.assistant_actions where conversation_id = {{conv_x}}

checks.name: 프로젝트 키 — 같은 업체 같은 키는 하나
checks.sql: insert into public.projects (company_id, customer_id, title, idempotency_key) values ({{company_x}}, {{cust_x}}, 'probe 2', 'act:k1')

checks.name: 프로젝트 키 — 다른 업체는 같은 키도 되고, 키 없는 줄은 여럿
checks.sql: insert into public.projects (company_id, customer_id, title, idempotency_key) values ({{company_y}}, {{cust_y}}, 'probe', 'act:k1'), ({{company_x}}, {{cust_x}}, 'probe 3', null), ({{company_x}}, {{cust_x}}, 'probe 4', null)

checks.name: 수금 키 — 같은 수주 같은 키는 하나, 다른 수주는 된다
checks.sql: insert into public.order_payments (order_id, stage, amount, due_on, idempotency_key) values ({{order_y}}, 'deposit', 5, '2026-11-10', 'act:k1'); insert into public.order_payments (order_id, stage, amount, due_on, idempotency_key) values ({{order_x}}, 'balance', 5, '2026-11-10', 'act:k1')

checks.name: 원가 키 — 같은 수주 같은 키는 하나, 다른 수주는 된다
checks.sql: insert into public.order_costs (order_id, category, amount, idempotency_key) values ({{order_y}}, 'material', 5, 'act:k1'); insert into public.order_costs (order_id, category, amount, idempotency_key) values ({{order_x}}, 'hardware', 5, 'act:k1')

checks.name: 키 길이 — 200자 넘으면 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.order_costs (order_id, category, amount, idempotency_key) values ({{order_y}}, 'material', 5, repeat('k', 201))

checks.name: 기록 종류 action
checks.sql: insert into public.assistant_audit (company_id, user_id, kind, name, detail) values ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'action', 'order_status', '{"state":"done"}'::jsonb)
